newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's South Cairo Flour Mills sees lower pre-tax 96/76 profit.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's South Cairo Flour Mills sees lower pre-tax 96/76 profit.

text.p: Egypt's partially privatised South Cairo Flour Mills forecast net pre-tax profits of 28 million pounds ($8.2 million) in the financial year 1996/7, against 28.931 million in 1995/6, corporate sources said on Monday. The year ends June 30.
The company estimated the 1996/7 dividend would be 3.15 pounds, against 3.25 in the previous year, they added.
The sources said the company announced the figures at an annual meeting of shareholders on Sunday.

The state sold 40 percent of South Cairo Flour Mills last year as part of its privatisation programme. The shares were sold at 26 pounds. On Monday they closed at 69.70 pounds, 0.30 pounds down on Sunday.
